summary: A member is quietly assigned a job at church before agreeing to it.
realLife: A woman recalling the late 1970s said that after high school she helped whenever called on at church, and joked she was voluntold.
sources: From the Rock Wall, oral history clip of a church member: https://www.fromtherockwall.org/oral-histories/patricia-pat-jackson-on-her-work-in-the-church-clip
inGame: needs: congregation roles; an ask-to-help is a tie event between a member and the person asked

turns.summary: The person accepts and feels welcome.
turns.writesBack: tie to the elder warms; a role is held

turns.summary: The person agrees because refusing would be awkward.
turns.writesBack: quiet resentment; a promise to serve

turns.summary: The person says no and offers something smaller.
